title: CompletionProof
description: Proof that a specific actor consumed a specific permit for a specific action_type. Used for multi-actor quorum dependency resolution on POST /v1-evaluate.

action_type.description: The action_type (slug) that was completed by the prior actor.

actor_id.description: The actor who completed the action.

permit_id.description: The permit token (or its hash) issued when the action was permitted. The runtime looks this up against permit_uses and execution_evaluations to verify both consumption and actor/action binding.
